Oskar B: Starting Melbourne marketplace onboarding with EdgeGrid. Need quota numbers, entitlement role ARN, KMS confirmation, and a short launch timeline.

Maya K: EdgeGrid said they can supply 10x g5-like and 4x a10g-equivalent GPUs in au-southeast-2. They'll publish an AMI and provide an edge cache.

Taro - EdgeGrid: Correct. We'll also stand up a small edge pool in Melbourne CBD for lower p95 latency. What's your expected traffic shape?

Oskar B: Target launch day: ~8k req/day, peak ~250 r/s, avg ~300 tokens/request. Requesting 2x headroom. Please size quota accordingly.

Maya K: I'll open the AWS quota ticket for 28 GPUs and two EBS-optimized control instances. Also requesting an entitlement role to be created in partner account.

Taro - EdgeGrid: Listing account 222333444555. Proposed SKU: EG-MEL-2026. KMS ARN for AMI encryption: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-2:222333444555:key/mnop-1122.

ops-bot: Quota ticket Q-10111 created and assigned to @Maya K. AWS ETA ~72h.

Maya K: Please create a role named redwood_mel_entitlement with trust for arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/marketplace-deploy and post the role ARN here.

Taro - EdgeGrid: Will create role today and post ARN. We'll also upload SOC docs to the shared drive and link them to the legal ticket.

LegalBot: Legal flag: if partner holds KMS, we need a short KMS usage agreement and an in-region data flow diagram before public messaging. Opening LG-5032.

Oskar B: Timeline proposal: Day 0 quotas + role + legal ticket, Day 2 AMI import + staging, Day 5 canary (~5% flagged), Day 10 public announce (pending sign-offs).

Maya K: Once quota is approved I'll spin a 3-node staging pool and run perf tests. Will post results and cost numbers here.

ops-bot: Q-10111 updated: AWS quota approved (AQ-94000). Verify resources now.

Taro - EdgeGrid: Role ARN posted: arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/redwood_mel_entitlement. AMI upload scheduled in 18h.

Oskar B: Thanks all — I'll track actions in the partner checklist and run a short sync tomorrow morning. :rocket:
